findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_record" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: One record by its id (`<source id>:<record id>`), with every stored version where the allowance includes history; with as_of (ISO 8601 with a time zone) too, th…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_offices · Private data: list_kinds, list_offices, find_company, get_company, find_address, search_records, get_record, list_changes, ask_for_data · Public sink: list_offices · Destructive: ask_for_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_offices · Private data: list_kinds, list_offices, find_company, get_company, find_address, search_records, get_record, list_changes, ask_for_data · Public sink: list_offices · Destructive: ask_for_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
